definitionZh: @view- Transition CSS at-rule 用于在当前和目的文件中选择进行视图转换,如果是交叉文档导航.
sourceDefinition: The @view-transition CSS at-rule is used to opt in the current and destination documents to undergo a view transition, in the case of a cross-document navigation.
